baseline.routing: 64 routed experts; top-6; selected weights not renormalized; 2 shared experts

claim_units.admissible_claim: At most: a locally positive diagnostic intersection that failed the required earlier-layer downstream test. No practical method or Eureka claim.
claim_units.label: possibly novel intersection
claim_units.reasoning: Counterfactual expert routes and token/expert-adaptive precision are both direct prior art. The targeted search did not locate the exact frozen-model Cartesian selection of an alternative equal-compute expert subset and a per-route Q3/Q4 mask against teacher full-vocabulary KL. This is negative search evidence only.
claim_units.technical_evidence: H1's exhaustive layer-26 oracle required 9.831% validation and 12.240% test Q4 upgrades, but the preregistered layer-23 intervention required 75.521% and 70.508%; the <=15% downstream gate and >=25% hard-stop both failed.

claim_units.admissible_claim: An exact negative ceiling for the registered DeepSeek-V2-Lite slate, not a new serving system.
claim_units.claim: Blockwise route coalescing over explicit equivalence classes
claim_units.label: close/overlapping
claim_units.reasoning: Speculative and parallel-decoding systems already optimize union size, expert reuse, shared verifier sets, depth-aware coalescing, or block coresets. Explicit KL-certified equivalence classes plus an exact set-union ILP are a narrower formulation, not a defensible broad novelty claim.
claim_units.technical_evidence: H2's exact block-8 ILP reduced natural union by 19.65% validation and 20.24% test, below the >=40% gate and the 25% hard-falsification boundary; all 1,280 ILPs were optimal.

claim_units.admissible_claim: A falsified, narrowly specified intersection; no precision controller or runtime claim.
claim_units.claim: Randomized residual syndrome for precision acquisition
claim_units.label: possibly novel intersection
claim_units.reasoning: Linear/JL sketches, residual-error estimation, residual quantization and adaptive bit slices are established. The exact intersection—a small randomized checksum of the actual Q3→Q4 expert-output residual used to request the next bitplane—was not located in the bounded search.
claim_units.technical_evidence: H4 met KL-recovery (84.35% validation, 82.26% test) but failed high-damage false negatives (22.73%/24.68% vs <=1%), down-only attribution (53.76%/65.89% vs >=70%), and the hardware model (24.30% vs <10%).

claim_units.admissible_claim: A research question only. It cannot be described as a demonstrated method, novel contribution, runtime, or Eureka result.
claim_units.label: not searched sufficiently
claim_units.reasoning: Every pair or major subset is densely occupied: route+bits, bits+cache, atoms+runtime, route+cache, and block+cache. No exact four-axis optimizer was located, but the project never implemented one, the required component gates failed, and the patent search was not exhaustive enough to label the full conjunction.
claim_units.technical_evidence: H1, H2, H3 and H4 failed their required downstream/full-depth/system gates. H5, H9 and PACKED_RUNTIME remained dependency-blocked, so no joint candidate exists.

claim_units.claim: Custom kernel or layout for CRAFT-MoE
claim_units.label: clearly prior art
claim_units.reasoning: Bit-packed MoE layouts, bespoke quantized decoders, sparse expert/neuron kernels, rerouting masks, and hardware co-design are established. A kernel's numerical semantics also require exact compatibility controls.
claim_units.technical_evidence: CRAFT-MoE produced accounting and component microbenchmarks only. PACKED_RUNTIME was blocked and there is no custom packed kernel or end-to-end decode speedup.

limitations: The literature cutoff is 2026-08-10; future and unindexed work is absent.
The search is targeted rather than a systematic-review database export.
No citation graph, full-text similarity corpus, non-English database, or thesis repository was exhaustively searched.
The patent pass is a limited keyword search and supports no legal conclusion.
Several 2026 sources are preprints; their reported results were not independently reproduced here.
A possibly novel intersection label is negative search evidence only and never a novelty determination.

mandatory_families.assessment: Cache-aware promotion, residency-aware route selection, partial expert residency, and prefetch overlap are established mechanisms. CRAFT cannot claim cache-conditioned routing or cache-aware expert selection broadly.
mandatory_families.label: clearly prior art

mandatory_families.assessment: Evaluating frozen-model alternative equal-compute routes and showing that non-natural routes can improve downstream utility is direct prior art. CRAFT's exhaustive top-12-choose-6 KL protocol is a narrower diagnostic distinction.
mandatory_families.label: clearly prior art

mandatory_families.assessment: Resident substitution, similarity rerouting, residency-aware routing, dynamic allocation, and custom rerouting kernels overlap strongly. None performs the exact frozen-model joint route-and-bit oracle tested in CRAFT.
mandatory_families.label: close/overlapping

mandatory_families.assessment: Dual expert/precision routing, residual bit slices, on-demand precision, bit-sliced caching, and routing-aware PTQ are occupied. The exact selection of a different expert subset jointly with per-expert Q3/Q4 masks was not found.
mandatory_families.family: D²MoE, SliceMoE, MoBiQuant and routing-consistent PTQ
mandatory_families.label: close/overlapping

mandatory_families.assessment: Neuron-level expert decomposition, activation-based neuron skipping, sub-expert scheduling, sparse MVM execution, and associated kernels are all prior art.
mandatory_families.family: FloE, intra-expert activation sparsity, MoE-Prism and Mixture of Neuron Experts
mandatory_families.label: clearly prior art

mandatory_families.assessment: The activated expert union is already an explicit optimization target across a draft tree or parallel block. EdgeXpert even uses depth-aware expert coalescing, while DES uses a sequence-level expert coreset. CRAFT's explicit KL-equivalence slates and exact ILP differ, but the broad system idea is occupied.
mandatory_families.family: EcoSpec, AcceptMoE, EdgeXpert, MoE-Spec and speculative expert prefetch
mandatory_families.label: close/overlapping

mandatory_families.assessment: Post-trained token-dependent expert skipping and learned masks are occupied, including physical kernels. These methods require adaptation or learned gates and are not the same as CRAFT's teacher-oracle equivalent-route enumeration.
mandatory_families.family: ZEDA, BEAM and post-trained dynamic expert skipping
mandatory_families.label: close/overlapping

mandatory_families.assessment: Random norm-preserving sketches, residual-error sketches, recursive residual quantization, and adaptive residual bit slices all predate CRAFT. The targeted use of a tiny sketch of an MoE expert's Q3→Q4 output residual as a per-token precision decision was not located.
mandatory_families.family: Random/JL sketches and adaptive bitplane acquisition
mandatory_families.label: close/overlapping

methodology.negative_search_rule: Failure to locate an exact combination is not evidence that it is new.
methodology.patent_scope: Limited keyword search in Google Patents on 2026-08-10; not a legal search, claim chart, CPC-class search, family search, prosecution-history review, or FTO analysis.
methodology.source_policy: Primary papers, official proceedings/code, and patent publications for technical evidence; secondary pages only for discovery.

overall.decision: Do not claim a new compressor, optimizer, kernel, runtime speedup, or Eureka. Describe CRAFT-MoE as a preregistered negative-results and oracle-ceiling study.
overall.inference: Two exact intersections were not located in this bounded search, but both were technically falsified in CRAFT and cannot support a contribution claim.
overall.measured_fact: The only locally strong new intersections failed required downstream, full-depth, union-reduction, safety, or hardware gates.
overall.prior_art_finding: Route alternatives, cache-conditioned selection, block-level expert-union optimization, token-adaptive residual precision, neuron sparsity, and custom execution paths are all represented in primary prior art.

patent_keyword_audit.conclusion: The records reinforce that residual quantization, partial expert-weight caching, random-projection compression, and sparse MoE weights are not blank territory. They do not establish the absence or presence of any legally controlling claim.

acceptmoe.evidence: Chooses a block-level verifier expert set from router scores, commitment probability, and—in offloading—cache residency.
acceptmoe.title: AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding

beam.evidence: Learns token-adaptive binary masks over routed experts and implements a custom CUDA/vLLM path that skips masked computation.
beam.title: BEAM: Binary Expert Activation Masking for Dynamic Routing in MoE

buddymoe.evidence: Uses profiled expert redundancy and resident buddy substitution to handle prefetch misses without simply dropping the missing expert.
buddymoe.title: BuddyMoE: Exploiting Expert Redundancy to Accelerate Memory-Constrained Mixture-of-Experts Inference

cache_conditional.evidence: Training-free cache-aware routing; Max Rank promotes resident experts within a bounded rank and Cache-Prior biases router ranking. Evaluated on mobile hardware.
cache_conditional.title: Mixture of Cache-Conditional Experts for Efficient Mobile Device Inference

counterfactual_routing.evidence: Scores sampled equal-compute alternative routes in frozen MoEs, including DeepSeek-V2-Lite, using downstream next-token utility.
counterfactual_routing.title: When Are Experts Misrouted? Counterfactual Routing Analysis in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

d2moe_delta.evidence: A distinct D²-MoE work that decomposes experts into a Fisher-merged shared base plus compressed expert-specific deltas.
d2moe_delta.title: Delta Decompression for MoE-based LLMs Compression

d2moe_delta_code.evidence: Official implementation linked by the delta-decompression paper.
d2moe_delta_code.title: Official D²-MoE delta-decompression implementation

d2moe_dynamic.evidence: Combines expert routing with dynamic expert bit-width allocation, nested Matryoshka weights, and bit-aware I/O/compute scheduling.
d2moe_dynamic.title: D2MoE: Dual Routing and Dynamic Scheduling for Efficient On-Device MoE-based LLM Serving

dynamic_expert_sharing.evidence: Selects a compact sequence-level expert coreset for an entire parallel-decoding block, directly optimizing expert reuse.
dynamic_expert_sharing.title: Dynamic Expert Sharing: Decoupling Memory from Parallelism in Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion LLMs

ecospec.evidence: EcoSpec selects draft paths using marginal expert-union cost and reuse in a dynamic expert buffer while preserving target verification.
ecospec.title: Less Experts, Faster Decoding: Cost-Aware Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts

edgexpert.evidence: Uses shared expert sets and depth-aware expert coalescing; loads salient channels rather than the complete union and supplies hardware co-design.
edgexpert.title: EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding

floe.evidence: Compresses internal expert matrices, predicts inter- and intra-expert sparsity, and implements sparse execution kernels with measured wall-clock results.
floe.title: FloE: On-the-Fly MoE Inference on Memory-constrained GPU

intra_expert_sparsity.evidence: Finds substantial neuron-level sparsity in pretrained MoEs and extends vLLM to skip inactive-neuron computation.
intra_expert_sparsity.title: Uncovering Intra-expert Activation Sparsity for Efficient Mixture-of-Expert Model Execution

jl_elementary.evidence: Foundational norm/distance preservation by randomized low-dimensional projection; establishes that the sketch primitive itself is old.
jl_elementary.title: An Elementary Proof of a Theorem of Johnson and Lindenstrauss

mobiquant.evidence: Uses recursive residual quantization and a token-aware router to select runtime precision from additive residual slices.
mobiquant.title: MoBiQuant: Mixture-of-Bits Quantization for Token-Adaptive Any-Precision LLM

moe_eras.evidence: Selects experts using both model quality and current residency through thresholding or biasing, on top of caching and quantization.
moe_eras.title: MoE-ERAS: Expert Residency Aware Selection

moe_prism.evidence: Refactors experts into neuron-group sub-experts and schedules their online activation under service-level constraints.
moe_prism.title: MoE-Prism: Disentangling Monolithic Experts for Elastic MoE Services via Model-System Co-Designs

moe_spec.evidence: Applies training-free layerwise expert capacity limits during parallel draft verification to bound the activated expert union.
moe_spec.title: MoE-Spec: Expert Budgeting for Efficient Speculative Decoding

mone.evidence: Decomposes each expert into neuron-granular experts and performs per-expert top-k neuron selection.
mone.title: Mixture of Neuron Experts

numerical_state.evidence: Shows that operand conversion, accumulator precision, and reduction order can belong to the numerical compatibility contract of sparse-MoE runtimes.
numerical_state.title: From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference

optimal_residual_sketch.evidence: Studies linear sketches specifically for estimating residual error and proves dimension bounds; not an MoE precision controller.
optimal_residual_sketch.title: Optimal Sketching for Residual Error Estimation for Matrix and Vector Norms

patent_partial_hot_expert.evidence: Patent publication describes full and partial expert-weight buffers, chunked compute, asynchronous prefetch, and cache updates from expert usage.
patent_partial_hot_expert.title: US20250356164A1 — MoE inference with full and partial hot expert buffers

patent_random_projection.evidence: Patent publication applies pseudo-random projection structures to machine-learning compression; it is not an MoE residual precision gate.
patent_random_projection.title: US20250156706A1 — Pseudo random projection for machine learning compression

patent_residual_quant.evidence: Patent record with 2018 priority covering residual quantization mechanisms for neural networks; no conclusion is made about legal scope here.
patent_residual_quant.title: US11586883B2 — Residual quantization for neural networks

patent_sparse_moe_weights.evidence: Patent publication covers MoE execution with sparsified expert weights at a broad level; no claim-scope comparison was performed.
patent_sparse_moe_weights.title: US20230316042A1 — Mixture of experts models with sparsified weights

puzzlemoe.evidence: Introduces a bit-packed MoE encoding and measured GPU inference in addition to sparse expert merging.
puzzlemoe.title: PuzzleMoE: Efficient Compression of Large Mixture-of-Experts Models via Sparse Expert Merging and Bit-packed inference

qmoe.evidence: Co-designs a custom sub-1-bit format and bespoke GPU decoding kernels for compressed MoE execution.
qmoe.title: QMoE: Practical Sub-1-Bit Compression of Trillion-Parameter Models

remoe.evidence: Training-time ReLU routing enables dynamic allocation across tokens and layers; it is not a frozen-model post-training route optimizer.
remoe.title: ReMoE: Fully Differentiable Mixture-of-Experts with ReLU Routing

sere.evidence: Re-routes secondary experts to similar primary experts, preserves critical experts, and supplies a vLLM CUDA kernel.
sere.title: SERE: Similarity-based Expert Re-routing for Efficient Batch Decoding in MoE Models

sere_code.evidence: Official calibration and vLLM/CUDA implementation linked by the paper.
sere_code.title: Official SERE implementation

slicemoe.evidence: Caches expert bit slices, assigns precision on demand, uses Matryoshka quantization and predictive cache warmup, including DeepSeek-V2-Lite results.
slicemoe.title: SliceMoE: Bit-Sliced Expert Caching under Miss-Rate Constraints for Efficient MoE Inference

specprefetch.evidence: Predicts next-layer expert candidates only for asynchronous transfer and uses a window-aware cache/bandwidth scheduler without changing native routing.
specprefetch.title: SpecPrefetch: Parameter-Efficient Expert Prefetching for Sparse MoE Foundation Models

vsraq.evidence: MoE-specific PTQ objective preserves routing values, ordering, and top-k boundaries under quantization.
vsraq.title: Value-and-Structure Alignment for Routing-Consistent Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts Models

zeda.evidence: ZEDA converts a trained static MoE to dynamic execution using zero experts and two-stage self-distillation, eliminating over half of expert FLOPs.
zeda.title: Post-Trained MoE Can Skip Half Experts via Self-Distillation
